lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca5Cu8SbO12 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers coordinated by four O neighbors, while Ca adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors and Sb is six-coordinate to O; O centers show two- or three-coordinate environments. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between 12-vertex Ca polyhedra and between 12-vertex Ca and 6-vertex Sb polyhedra, with edge-sharing also observed among Ca polyhedra.
